name_en: Kagawa barazushi — scattered sushi rice mixed with simmered vegetables and seafood
summary_ja: 酢飯に里芋やごぼう、しいたけなどの具を混ぜ込み、サワラの酢じめや錦糸卵を彩りに添える。祭りや婚礼など人が集まるハレの日のごちそうとして各家庭でつくられてきたという。
summary_en: Vinegared rice is mixed with simmered taro, burdock, and shiitake, then topped with vinegar-cured Spanish mackerel and shredded egg for color. Long made at home for festivals, weddings, and other gatherings as a celebratory dish.
source_title: ばらずし 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Kankan zushi — vinegar-cured mackerel pressed sushi from Sanuki
summary_ja: 酢でしめたサワラをすし飯の上に並べ、木箱に詰めてくさびで押し固めた保存性の高いすし。さぬき市鴨部地域が発祥とされ、木槌で打ち込む音がカンカンと響くことから名がついたという。
summary_en: Vinegar-cured Spanish mackerel is laid over sushi rice, packed into a wooden box, and pressed tight with wedges for a long shelf life. Said to originate in the Kamobe area of Sanuki City, its name comes from the kan-kan sound of the mallet driving the wedges home.
source_title: カンカンずし 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Oshinuki zushi — mold-pressed sushi topped with Spanish mackerel and fava bean
summary_ja: 型に詰めたすし飯にサワラの切り身やそら豆、卵焼きを彩りよく並べて押し出す。春、脂の乗ったサワラを買って親類を招く「春祝魚」という讃岐の風習の主役として食べられてきたという。
summary_en: Sushi rice packed into a mold is topped with slices of Spanish mackerel, fava bean, and rolled omelet before being pressed out. Said to be the centerpiece of harusanuo, a Sanuki custom of buying a whole spring mackerel and inviting relatives to share it.
source_title: 押し抜きずし 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
